firmware.title: June Pixel Drop update available
firmware.description:
Your Pixel is getting even better with the latest features and enhancements along with Android 17.

Learn more at our Community page.

What's new?

  • With Screen reactions, you can now record a selfie video overlay while capturing what’s on your screen, all without needing extra apps.[1]
  • Gemini Omni makes creating and editing videos as easy as having a conversation. Blend text, images, and videos to bring your ideas to life.[2]
  • Describe an idea or upload a photo, and it’ll be transformed into a high-quality audio track with lyrics in Gemini.[3]
  • Easily turn your apps into floating bubbles over your main screen to check them quickly or multitask without disrupting your flow.[4]

1 Screen reactions are only available when screen recording is set to record the entire screen.

2 Google AI subscription required. Features vary by tier and geography. 18+.

3 Limits apply. Compatibility varies. 18+. Create responsibly.

4 Limited to 5 apps at a time.


Downloading updates over a mobile network or while roaming may cause additional charges.

firmware.title: November Pixel Drop update available
firmware.description:
Your Pixel is getting better with the latest features and enhancements. Learn more on our Community page.

What's new?

• Give your phone a makeover with brand-new custom icon styles. Redesign all your home screen icons with a consistent look.

• Transit Mode now can turn on automatically when your phone detects you’re on a train. It adjusts your sound, turns on Bluetooth, and can turn on Motion Assist for smoother browsing. [1]

• Pixel search helps you find what you need across your phone, from vacation photos and recent emails to messages, calendar events, and device settings. [2]

• Unit Conversion module instantly handles inline math, mixed units, and real-time currency conversion in the Calculator app so you never have to jump between apps or search engines again.

• The latest Pixel VIP update lets you easily request and share real-time locations, view full addresses, and check your VIP's phone battery percentage directly from the VIP hub.

• Pixel Settings now includes Family Hub making it easier to manage your household, check location sharing and subscriptions in one spot. [3]

• Message notification summaries and organizer now in more countries and languages. [4]


[1] Automatic train detection and Motion Assist in Transit Mode are off by default and can be turned on in Settings.

[2] Available for select devices, countries, and languages to users 18+. Feature availability will vary; may require subscription for higher usage. Check responses.

[3] Available on Pixel 6 and newer devices. Top-level Settings shortcut requires an active Google family group. Sharing Google One benefits requires an eligible plan.

[4] Available on Pixel 9 and newer phones (excluding Pixel 9a and Pixel 10a) in select countries and languages.


Downloading updates over a cellular network, metered Wi-Fi, or while roaming may cause additional charges.
